target: 2027 monthly average concurrent category activity; fixed historical cohort

selection_rationale.Action: Last value retained: challengers did not improve mean error reliably
selection_rationale.Massively Multiplayer: Last value retained: challengers offered no useful average advantage
selection_rationale.Indie: Original boosting retained: tiny trend addition is not persuasive; tuning worsens
selection_rationale.RPG: Tuned variability candidate retained provisionally: improved mean and worst-fold error
selection_rationale.Strategy: Untuned recent changes retained provisionally: three ML fold wins, modest gain over last value; worst-fold limitations retained

scope: Exploratory projection, not a validated current-market forecast or untouched-test result
evaluation_policy: Freeze output bytes now. Future matching 2027 observations may be scored without retuning; source/eligibility changes require separately versioned evaluation. Already-reviewed development outcomes are not a final holdout.
uncertainty: No calibrated prediction intervals established; model-policy differences are sensitivity comparisons, not confidence bounds
